result.title: Out-of-the-Box Tabular Foundation Models for Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
result.comment: Accepted at the AI4Mat Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 19 pages, 12 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/PriorLabs/matsci-bo-bench
result.summary: Bayesian optimization is widely used in active learning loops for materials science. Gaussian processes serve as the de-facto surrogate model family, but require task-dependent kernel choices and can lack the modeling capacity for complex relationships. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as the state-of-the-art for predictive tasks on structured data, without requiring bespoke kernels or hyperparameter tuning. We evaluate two TFMs, TabPFN and TabICL, as out-of-the-box surrogate models on two standard materials science benchmarks, comparing against a large field of baselines encompassing Gaussian processes, random forests, and CatBoost. Our findings indicate that TFMs are highly competitive surrogate models across the two benchmarks, without task-specific training for active learning or GP kernel selection. Our results motivate developing TFMs further as surrogates for active learning in materials discovery.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在两个材料科学基准上把 TabPFN 与 TabICL 两种表格基础模型直接作为贝叶斯优化代理模型，与高斯过程、随机森林和 CatBoost 等基线对比，发现其无需任务特定训练或核函数选择也能保持竞争力。
AI.relevance_reason: 材料主动学习与视觉多模态推理相距较远，但贝叶斯优化中以不确定性驱动“继续获取证据还是停止”的采集函数设计，可能为 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 决策与证据筛选评价提供可供核查的形式化视角。
